metadata.description: Sample National Coverage Determinations for common procedures

ncds.title: Evaluation and Management Services - Office Visits
limitations: Services must be reasonable and necessary for diagnosis or treatment
Documentation must support the level of service billed
Services must be within the scope of the provider's license

ncds.title: Preventive Services - Annual Wellness Visit
limitations: One annual wellness visit per 12-month period
Patient must be enrolled in Medicare Part B
